chain.label: Undetermined surface pit in fitting radius
chain.trigger: Fatigue originated from a small surface pit of undetermined source

chain.label: Fatigue fracture of right forward landing gear fitting
chain.trigger: the probable cause of the accident was the fatigue failure of the upper right forward fitting of the right main landing gear tube assembly

caused_by.evidence: Fatigue originated from a small surface pit of undetermined source

chain.label: Right main landing gear collapses and separates from fuselage
chain.trigger: The right main landing gear had separated from its upper ... and lower ... fuselage attachment fittings and was lying beneath the aircraft

caused_by.evidence: the fitting ... had fractured ... Approximately 40 percent of the fractured cross sectional area of the fitting appeared cracked. The remaining sections ... were typical of overload separations

chain.label: Aircraft rolls over onto its right side
chain.trigger: The crumpling sound was accompanied by a settling and yawing motion, followed by a roll of the aircraft to the right

caused_by.evidence: All fatalities were caused by the operating rotor blades as a result of the collapse of the landing gear

chain.label: Rotating main rotor blades strike heliport concrete and blade sections separate
chain.trigger: the aircraft continued the roll and the main rotor blades struck the heliport concrete surface

caused_by.evidence: With the ESC's in the shutoff position, the aircraft continued the roll and the main rotor blades struck the heliport concrete surface

chain.label: Fatalities and injuries from separated rotor blade strikes
chain.trigger: four passengers who were still outside the aircraft and were waiting to board were killed and one was seriously injured. One pedestrian ... was killed and another was seriously injured when they were struck by a separated portion of one of the main rotor blades

caused_by.evidence: All fatalities were caused by the operating rotor blades as a result of the collapse of the landing gear
